parameters.jsCode: const x=$json; if(!x.source_id&&!x.path) throw new Error('source_id or path is required'); const raw=String(x.tenant||'default')+':'+String(x.source_id||x.path); let h=2166136261; for(let i=0;i<raw.length;i++){h^=raw.charCodeAt(i); h=Math.imul(h,16777619);} const document_id='doc_'+(h>>>0).toString(16).padStart(8,'0'); const type=String(x.type||'').toLowerCase(); let steps; if(type==='created') steps=['LOAD','CHUNK','EMBED','UPSERT']; else if(type==='updated') steps=['DELETE_OLD_VERSION','LOAD','CHUNK','EMBED','UPSERT']; else if(type==='deleted') steps=['DELETE_BY_DOCUMENT_ID']; else throw new Error('unsupported lifecycle event'); return [{json:{...x,document_id,steps,metadata:{document_id,tenant:x.tenant||'default',source_id:x.source_id||null,path:x.path||null,version:Number(x.version||1)}}}];

return [{json:{document_id:$json.document_id,steps:$json.steps,metadata_filter:{document_id:$json.document_id,tenant:$json.metadata.tenant},notice:'Update deletes old vectors before re-embedding; delete removes vectors by stable document identity.'}}];
